070        public static class ZigFIDConfig implements FIDConfigGen {
071                public FIDConfig createConfig() {
072                        FIDConfig config = new FIDConfig();
073                        
074//                      config.alwaysAttackVsAttack = true;
075//                      config.leaveAlwaysAvailable = true;
076//                      config.showFleetAttitude = false;
077                        config.showTransponderStatus = false;
078                        config.showEngageText = false;
079                        config.alwaysPursue = true;
080                        config.dismissOnLeave = false;
081                        //config.lootCredits = false;
082                        config.withSalvage = false;
083                        //config.showVictoryText = false;
084                        config.printXPToDialog = true;
085                        
086                        config.noSalvageLeaveOptionText = "Continue";
087//                      config.postLootLeaveOptionText = "Continue";
088//                      config.postLootLeaveHasShortcut = false;
089                        
090                        config.delegate = new BaseFIDDelegate() {
091                                public void postPlayerSalvageGeneration(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, FleetEncounterContext context, CargoAPI salvage) {
092                                        new RemnantFleetInteractionConfigGen().createConfig().delegate.
093                                                                postPlayerSalvageGeneration(dialog, context, salvage);
094                                }
095                                public void notifyLeave(InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
096                                        
097                                        SectorEntityToken other = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
098                                        if (!(other instanceof CampaignFleetAPI)) {
099                                                dialog.dismiss();
100                                                return;
101                                        }
102                                        CampaignFleetAPI fleet = (CampaignFleetAPI) other;
103                                        
104                                        if (!fleet.isEmpty()) {
105                                                dialog.dismiss();
106                                                return;
107                                        }
108                                        
109                                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(DEFEATED_ZIGGURAT_KEY, true);
110                                        
111                                        PersonAPI callisto = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople().getData(People.IBRAHIM).getPerson();
112                                        PersonAPI gargoyle = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople().getData(People.GARGOYLE).getPerson();
113                                        MarketAPI culann = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("culann");
114                                        MarketAPI donn = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("donn");
115                                        PersonAPI arroyo = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople().getData(People.ARROYO).getPerson();
116                                        
117                                        if (culann != null && culann.getMemoryWithoutUpdate() != null) {
118                                                Misc.makeNonStoryCritical(culann.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), Missions.ZIGGURAT);
119                                        }
120                                        if (donn != null && donn.getMemoryWithoutUpdate() != null) {
121                                                Misc.makeNonStoryCritical(donn.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), Missions.ZIGGURAT);
122                                        }
123                                        if (callisto != null && callisto.getMarket() != null && callisto.getMarket().getMemoryWithoutUpdate() != null) {
124                                                Misc.makeNonStoryCritical(callisto.getMarket().getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), Missions.ZIGGURAT);
125                                        }
126                                        if (arroyo != null && arroyo.getMarket() != null && arroyo.getMarket().getMemoryWithoutUpdate() != null) {
127                                                Misc.makeNonStoryCritical(arroyo.getMarket().getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), Missions.ZIGGURAT);
128                                        }
129                                        if (gargoyle != null && gargoyle.getMarket() != null && gargoyle.getMarket().getMemoryWithoutUpdate() != null) {
130                                                Misc.makeNonStoryCritical(gargoyle.getMarket().getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), Missions.ZIGGURAT);
131                                        }
132                                        
133                                        
134                                        
135                                        PerShipData ship = new PerShipData("ziggurat_Hull", ShipCondition.WRECKED, 0f);
136                                        ship.shipName = "TTS Xenorphica";
137                                        DerelictShipData params = new DerelictShipData(ship, false);
138                                        CustomCampaignEntityAPI entity = (CustomCampaignEntityAPI) BaseThemeGenerator.addSalvageEntity(
139                                                                                                fleet.getContainingLocation(),
140                                                                                                Entities.WRECK, Factions.NEUTRAL, params);
141                                        Misc.makeImportant(entity, "ziggurat");
142                                        entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$ziggurat", true);
143                                        
144                                        entity.getLocation().x = fleet.getLocation().x + (50f - (float) Math.random() * 100f);
145                                        entity.getLocation().y = fleet.getLocation().y + (50f - (float) Math.random() * 100f);
146                        
147                                        ShipRecoverySpecialData data = new ShipRecoverySpecialData(null);
148                                        data.notNowOptionExits = true;
149                                        data.noDescriptionText = true;
150                                        DerelictShipEntityPlugin dsep = (DerelictShipEntityPlugin) entity.getCustomPlugin();
151                                        PerShipData copy = (PerShipData) dsep.getData().ship.clone();
152                                        copy.variant = Global.getSettings().getVariant(copy.variantId).clone();
153                                        copy.variantId = null;
154                                        copy.variant.addTag(Tags.SHIP_CAN_NOT_SCUTTLE);
155                                        copy.variant.addTag(Tags.SHIP_UNIQUE_SIGNATURE);
156                                        
157                                        if (Misc.isExtended()) {
158                                                copy.condition = ShipCondition.PRISTINE; // so it doesn't get any random d-mods
159                                                copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.UNSTABLE_COILS);
160                                                copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.GLITCHED_SENSORS);
161                                                copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.DEGRADED_ENGINES);
162                                                copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.DEGRADED_DRIVE_FIELD);
163                                                copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.FAULTY_GRID);
164                                                copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.COMP_STRUCTURE);
165                                                copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.ERRATIC_INJECTOR);
166                                                copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.INCREASED_MAINTENANCE);
167                                                copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.COMP_ARMOR);
168                                                copy.variant.addPermaMod(HullMods.FAULTY_AUTO);
169                                        }
170                                        
171                                        data.addShip(copy);
172                                        
173                                        Misc.setSalvageSpecial(entity, data);
174                                        
175                                        dialog.setInteractionTarget(entity);
176                                        RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl plugin = new RuleBasedInteractionDialogPluginImpl("AfterZigguratDefeat");
177                                        dialog.setPlugin(plugin);
178                                        plugin.init(dialog);
179                                }

183                                        bcc.objectivesAllowed = false;
184                                        bcc.fightToTheLast = true;
185                                        bcc.enemyDeployAll = true;
186                                }
187                        };
188                        return config;
189                }

193        public void generate(SectorAPI sector) {
194                StarSystemAPI system = sector.createStarSystem("Unknown Location");
195                //system.setType(StarSystemType.NEBULA);
196                system.setName("Unknown Location"); // to get rid of "Star System" at the end of the name
197                system.setType(StarSystemType.DEEP_SPACE);
198                system.addTag(Tags.THEME_UNSAFE);
199                system.addTag(Tags.THEME_HIDDEN);
200                system.addTag(Tags.THEME_SPECIAL);
201                LocationAPI hyper = Global.getSector().getHyperspace();
202                
203                system.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MusicPlayerPluginImpl.MUSIC_SET_MEM_KEY, "music_campaign_alpha_site");
204                
205                system.setBackgroundTextureFilename("graphics/backgrounds/background4.jpg");
206                //system.getLocation().set(2500, 3000);
207                system.getLocation().set(4000, 2500);
208                
209                HyperspaceTerrainPlugin hyperTerrain = (HyperspaceTerrainPlugin) Misc.getHyperspaceTerrain().getPlugin();
210                NebulaEditor editor = new NebulaEditor(hyperTerrain);
211                editor.clearArc(system.getLocation().x, system.getLocation().y, 0, 200, 0, 360f);
212//              editor.regenNoise();
213//              editor.noisePrune(0.8f);
214//              editor.regenNoise();
215
216                SectorEntityToken center = system.initNonStarCenter();
217                
218                system.setLightColor(new Color(225,170,255,255)); // light color in entire system, affects all entities
219                center.addTag(Tags.AMBIENT_LS);
220                
221                String type = "barren";
222                type = "irradiated";
223                PlanetAPI rock = system.addPlanet("site_alpha", center, "Alpha Site", type, 0, 150, 1200, 40);
224                //rock.setCustomDescriptionId("???");
225                rock.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$ttBlackSite", true);
226                
227                rock.getMarket().addCondition(Conditions.NO_ATMOSPHERE);
228                rock.getMarket().addCondition(Conditions.COLD);
229                rock.getMarket().addCondition(Conditions.DARK);
230                rock.getMarket().addCondition(Conditions.IRRADIATED);
231                rock.getMarket().addCondition(Conditions.RUINS_SCATTERED);
232                
233                rock.getMarket().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$ruinsExplored", true);
234                //If this is done, shows up in intel planet list; doesn't matter either way
235                //Misc.setFullySurveyed(rock.getMarket(), null, false);
236                
237                CoreLifecyclePluginImpl.addRuinsJunk(rock);
238                
239                rock.setOrbit(null);
240                rock.setLocation(1200, 300);
241                
242                SectorEntityToken field = system.addTerrain(Terrain.MAGNETIC_FIELD,
243                                                new MagneticFieldParams(150f, // terrain effect band width 
244                                                500, // terrain effect middle radius
245                                                rock, // entity that it's around
246                                                350f, // visual band start
247                                                650f, // visual band end
248                                                new Color(60, 60, 150, 90), // base color
249                                                1f, // probability to spawn aurora sequence, checked once/day when no aurora in progress
250                                                new Color(130, 60, 150, 130),
251                                                new Color(150, 30, 120, 150), 
252                                                new Color(200, 50, 130, 190),
253                                                new Color(250, 70, 150, 240),
254                                                new Color(200, 80, 130, 255),
255                                                new Color(75, 0, 160, 255), 
256                                                new Color(127, 0, 255, 255)
257                                                ));
258                field.setCircularOrbit(rock, 0, 0, 75);
259                
260                CustomCampaignEntityAPI beacon = system.addCustomEntity(null, null, Entities.WARNING_BEACON, Factions.NEUTRAL);
261                beacon.setCircularOrbitPointingDown(rock, 0, 2500, 60);
262                
263                beacon.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$ttBlackSite", true);
264                beacon.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(WarningBeaconEntityPlugin.PING_ID_KEY, Pings.WARNING_BEACON3);
265                beacon.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(WarningBeaconEntityPlugin.PING_FREQ_KEY, 1.5f);
266                beacon.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(WarningBeaconEntityPlugin.PING_COLOR_KEY, new Color(250,125,0,255));
267                beacon.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(WarningBeaconEntityPlugin.GLOW_COLOR_KEY, new Color(250,55,0,255));
268                
269                
270                SectorEntityToken cache = BaseThemeGenerator.addSalvageEntity(system, Entities.ALPHA_SITE_WEAPONS_CACHE, Factions.NEUTRAL);
271                cache.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$ttWeaponsCache", true);
272                cache.addTag(Tags.SALVAGE_ENTITY_FULL_DROP_IN_EXT_MODE);
273                cache.getLocation().set(11111, 11111);
274                
275                if (Misc.isExtended() && Global.getSettings().getBoolean("ext_strongerAlphaSiteDefenders")) {
276                        Misc.setDefenderOverride(cache, new DefenderDataOverride(Factions.REMNANTS, 1f, 90, 110, 3));
277                }
278                
279//              JumpPointAPI jumpPoint = Global.getFactory().createJumpPoint("rock_jump_point", "Unstable Jump-point");
280//              OrbitAPI orbit = Global.getFactory().createCircularOrbit(rock, 0, 2500, 90);
281//              jumpPoint.setOrbit(orbit);
282//              //jumpPoint.setRelatedPlanet(magec2);
283//              jumpPoint.setStandardWormholeToHyperspaceVisual();
284//              system.addEntity(jumpPoint);
285                
286                system.generateAnchorIfNeeded();
287                
288                NascentGravityWellAPI well = Global.getSector().createNascentGravityWell(beacon, 50f);
289                well.addTag(Tags.NO_ENTITY_TOOLTIP);
290                well.setColorOverride(new Color(125, 50, 255));
291                hyper.addEntity(well);
292                well.autoUpdateHyperLocationBasedOnInSystemEntityAtRadius(beacon, 0);
293                
294                addFleet(rock);
295                
296                SectorEntityToken hamatsu = addDerelict(system, beacon, 
297                                                        "venture_Outdated", "ISS Hamatsu", HAMATSU_ID, ShipCondition.BATTERED, 200, true);
298                hamatsu.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$hamatsu", true);
299                
300                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(NASCENT_WELL_KEY, well);
301        }
302        
303        public static NascentGravityWellAPI getWell() {
304                return (NascentGravityWellAPI) Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get(NASCENT_WELL_KEY);
305        }

308        public static void addFleet(SectorEntityToken rock) {
309                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = FleetFactoryV3.createEmptyFleet(Factions.NEUTRAL, FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE, null);
310                fleet.setName("Unidentified Vessel");
311                fleet.setNoFactionInName(true);
312                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_MAKE_HOSTILE, true);
313                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_MAKE_AGGRESSIVE, true);
314                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_NO_REP_IMPACT, true);
315                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_LOW_REP_IMPACT, true);
316                //fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PATROL_FLEET, true); // so it keeps transponder on
317                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_NO_SHIP_RECOVERY, true);
318                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_MAKE_ALWAYS_PURSUE, true);
319                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$ziggurat", true);
320                
321                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MusicPlayerPluginImpl.KEEP_PLAYING_LOCATION_MUSIC_DURING_ENCOUNTER_MEM_KEY, true);
322                
323                
324                fleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember("ziggurat_Experimental");
325                fleet.getFleetData().ensureHasFlagship();
326                
327                fleet.clearAbilities();
328//              fleet.addAbility(Abilities.TRANSPONDER);
329//              fleet.getAbility(Abilities.TRANSPONDER).activate();
330                
331                // so it never shows as "Unidentified Fleet" but isn't easier to spot due to using the actual transponder ability
332                fleet.setTransponderOn(true);
333                
334                PersonAPI person = createZigguratCaptain();
335                fleet.setCommander(person);
336                
337                FleetMemberAPI flagship = fleet.getFlagship();
338                flagship.setCaptain(person);
339                flagship.updateStats();
340                flagship.getRepairTracker().setCR(flagship.getRepairTracker().getMaxCR());
341                flagship.setShipName("TTS Xenorphica");
342                
343                // to "perm" the variant so it gets saved and not recreated from the "ziggurat_Experimental" id
344                flagship.setVariant(flagship.getVariant().clone(), false, false);
345                flagship.getVariant().setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
346                flagship.getVariant().addTag(Tags.SHIP_LIMITED_TOOLTIP);
347
348                
349                Vector2f loc = new Vector2f(rock.getLocation().x + 300 * ((float) Math.random() - 0.5f),
350                                                                        rock.getLocation().y + 300 * ((float) Math.random() - 0.5f));
351                fleet.setLocation(loc.x, loc.y);
352                rock.getContainingLocation().addEntity(fleet);
353                
354                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.FLEET_INTERACTION_DIALOG_CONFIG_OVERRIDE_GEN, 
355                                   new ZigFIDConfig());
356                
357                fleet.addScript(new ZigLeashAssignmentAI(fleet, rock));
358                
359        }

362        public static PersonAPI createZigguratCaptain() {
363                PersonAPI person = Global.getFactory().createPerson();
364                person.setName(new FullName("Motes", "", Gender.ANY));
365                person.setFaction(Factions.NEUTRAL);
366                person.setPortraitSprite(Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("characters", "ziggurat_captain"));
367                person.setPersonality(Personalities.RECKLESS);
368                person.setRankId(Ranks.SPACE_CAPTAIN);
369                person.setPostId(null);
370                
371                person.getStats().setSkipRefresh(true);
372                
373                person.getStats().setLevel(10);
374                person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.HELMSMANSHIP, 2);
375                person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.TARGET_ANALYSIS, 2);
376                person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.IMPACT_MITIGATION, 2);
377                person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.GUNNERY_IMPLANTS, 2);
378                person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.ENERGY_WEAPON_MASTERY, 2);
379                person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.COMBAT_ENDURANCE, 2);
380                //person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.RELIABILITY_ENGINEERING, 2);
381                //person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.RANGED_SPECIALIZATION, 2);
382                person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.POLARIZED_ARMOR, 2);
383                person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.MISSILE_SPECIALIZATION, 2);
384                //person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.PHASE_MASTERY, 2);
385                person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.FIELD_MODULATION, 2);
386                person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.DAMAGE_CONTROL, 2);
387                
388                person.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.NAVIGATION, 1);
389                
390                person.getStats().setSkipRefresh(false);
391                
392                return person;
393        }

395        public static SectorEntityToken addDerelict(StarSystemAPI system, SectorEntityToken focus, 
396                                                           String variantId, String name, String id, 
397                                                           ShipCondition condition, float orbitRadius, boolean recoverable) {
398                DerelictShipData params = new DerelictShipData(new PerShipData(variantId, condition, 0f), false);
399                if (name != null) {
400                        params.ship.shipName = name;
401                        params.ship.nameAlwaysKnown = true;
402                        params.ship.fleetMemberId = id;
403                }
404                SectorEntityToken ship = BaseThemeGenerator.addSalvageEntity(system, Entities.WRECK, Factions.NEUTRAL, params);
405                ship.setDiscoverable(true);
406
407                float orbitDays = orbitRadius / (10f + (float) Math.random() * 5f);
408                ship.setCircularOrbit(focus, (float) Math.random() * 360f, orbitRadius, orbitDays);
409
410                if (recoverable) {
411                        ShipRecoverySpecialCreator creator = new ShipRecoverySpecialCreator(null, 0, 0, false, null, null);
412                        Misc.setSalvageSpecial(ship, creator.createSpecial(ship, null));
413                }
414                return ship;
415        }
